title: James Harden 51 vs Pacers: Passes Kobe for 3rd All-Time 🔥 #shorts
description:
James Harden scored 51 points as the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the Indiana Pacers 128–119 in the NBA Cup on Friday. It was Harden's 26th career 50-point game, moving him past Kobe Bryant for the third-most in NBA history. He shot 15 of 26, made 7 of 11 threes and all 14 free throws; Donovan Mitchell added 20 for the Cavs.
